description: The image displays two bar charts illustrating Fleiss Kappa values, a statistical measure of inter-rater agreement, across different conditions. The left chart presents Fleiss Kappa values for three distinct conditions: 0.88, 0.46, and 0.03, with the corresponding values 0.82 and 0.94 shown below the x-axis labels. The right chart shows Fleiss Kappa values for three conditions with Max Ambiguity levels of 1, 2, and 3, with values of 0.88, 0.46, and 0.23, respectively. Both charts use a vertical axis labeled "Fleiss Kappa" ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with the bars in the left chart colored in dark blue, medium blue, and light blue, while the bars in the right chart are colored in dark blue, medium blue, and light blue. The x-axis labels in the right chart are "1", "2", and "3", representing the Max Ambiguity levels. The bars in both charts are sorted in descending order of their Fleiss Kappa values.
